## Problem and result

Link the Issue/spec and explain the observable before/after behavior.

## Validation

- [ ] I recorded exact commands and pass/fail counts.
- [ ] I distinguished browser tests that passed from browser tests that were skipped.
- [ ] I stated the real-page acceptance scope; isolated browser tests are not described as seller-page acceptance.
- [ ] I tested failure behavior when the result can be uncertain.

## Compatibility and data

- [ ] Existing product, SKU, media-manifest, report, and ledger formats remain compatible, or migration evidence is included.
- [ ] Capability changes update `docs/compatibility.md`; operator changes update the user documentation.
- [ ] Formal publishing remains manual unless a separately approved specification changes that boundary.

## Evidence safety

- [ ] Screenshots and reports are sanitized.
- [ ] This PR contains no credentials, cookies, browser profiles, runtime directories, real store pages, or unnecessary product data.
